says: The README says next-ledger.json holds 115 entries with no-restricted-imports 71 and no-hooks 43, but at this head it holds 76: 63 no-restricted-imports and 13 no-hooks. The plan for ticket 921 has each slice update this count, and slice 1 did not.
proof: `python3 -c "import json,collections;e=json.load(open('next-ledger.json'))['entries'];print(len(e),collections.Counter(x.get('rule') for x in e))"` printed `76 Counter({'eslint(no-restricted-imports)': 63, 'vitest(no-hooks)': 13})`, while oxlint-plugins/README.md:530-531 reads `next-ledger.json holds 115 entries: id-denylist 0, no-restricted-imports 71, no-wall-clock 1 (next/apps/fabrika) and no-hooks 43`.
cost: A reader of the lint docs sees a list about 50% bigger than it is and cannot tell how far ticket 921 has paid it down.
